package rulefixtures

import "fmt"

// scenario for go_perf_layer_error_handling_cost_multierror_append_for_success_path: Layer: Error handling cost. Flag multi-error aggregators allocated on success-heavy paths before any error exists.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.

func ValidateItems(items []string) error {
	var errs []error
	for _, item := range items {
		errs = append(errs, validate(item))
	}
	if len(errs) > 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("validation failed: %v", errs)
	}
	return nil
}

func validate(item string) error {
	if item == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("empty item")
	}
	return nil
}
